column7:
Reduction in provision
by re-appropriation of
₹143.90 lakh was
attributed to anticipated
saving. Surrender of
₹6,525.67 lakh was
attributed to transfer of
officers and staff. Final
excess of ₹15.57 lakh is
overstated by ₹37.02
lakh due to clearance of
OB suspense related to
previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹21.45 lakh.
Reasons for actual
saving have not been
intimated (July 2024).
